extDescription.message: Clip the job posting on the current page straight into your JobFinder application tracker.

statusReading.message: Reading the job posting from this page…

statusRestricted.message: This page can't be read (browser-internal page). Open a job posting and try again — or fill in the fields manually.

successSaved.message: Saved! The job was added to your application tracker.

errNotConfigured.message: The extension isn't configured yet — set the server address and access code first.

errUnauthorized.message: The access code is missing or wrong (error 401). Update it in the settings.

errNetwork.message: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection and the API address in the settings.

optionsIntro.message: Point the clipper at your JobFinder instance. The defaults match the public deployment.

hintAppUrl.message: The web app address, e.g. https://jobfinder-hazel-pi.vercel.app or http://localhost:5173.

hintApiUrl.message: Leave empty to use the App URL plus /api. For local dev use http://localhost:8000.

hintAccessCode.message: Sent as the X-App-Key header. The public deployment rejects saves without it.
